enrichment.summary: The University of San Francisco will offer its Upward Bound college-prep project to district students at no cost. It includes workshops, one-on-one advising, help with course selection, college applications and financial aid. A separate data sharing agreement sets rules for how student data is shared with and protected by the university. Both run July 1, 2025 to June 30, 2027.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: No-Cost Services Agreement and Data Sharing Agreement - University of San Francisco - Upward Bound Project - High School Linked Learning Office

enrichment.headline: Accepts $650,000 from the Eat.Learn.Play Foundation for the Literacy Coaches Program
enrichment.summary: The district accepts a $650,000 grant from the Eat.Learn.Play Foundation to support the Literacy Coaches Program for students at all elementary schools. The grant covers July 1, 2025 to June 30, 2026.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

items.title: Grant Award - Eat.Learn.Play. Foundation - Academics and Instruction Department

enrichment.headline: Sets terms for workplace learning partners who host student interns, at no cost, for three years
enrichment.summary: This memorandum of understanding sets the rules for work training partners that coordinate workplace learning experiences for minors, including district students, in the Exploring College, Career, and Community Options (ECCCO) internship program. It covers incident and mandated reporting, legal notices, indemnification and insurance. It costs the district nothing and runs May 28, 2025 to May 28, 2028.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.summary: Oakland Public Education Fund will manage the stipend process for student interns in the summer Work Based Learning program (ECCCO) at LIFE Academy. It will issue payments as directed by the district, resolve problems, bill the district and send year-end tax forms. The agreement runs April 1 to June 30, 2025.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Pays a contractor up to $18,842.87 to teach instrumental music at Montera Middle School
enrichment.summary: An individual contractor will provide 185 to 190 hours of instrumental music instruction for Montera Middle School band students during scheduled music classes. Students work on instruments such as flute, clarinet, saxophone, trumpet, trombone and percussion and finish with a spring public performance. The work ran April 26 to May 30, 2025, and the board is approving it after it began.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.summary: AlciDesigns & Consulting will provide event planning and logistics support before and during the Linked Learning Practice Sharing event, arranged through the High School Linked Learning Department. The term is March 27 to June 30, 2025, and the board is approving it after it began.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.summary: The district and ASCEND Charter School agree on the charter school's use of the campus at 3709 E 12th St in Oakland for one year, under a Proposition 39 in-lieu facilities agreement. The district expects $288,645 in revenue in 2025-26. The term is July 1, 2025 to June 30, 2026.

enrichment.summary: The board approves a tentative agreement between the district and AFSCME Local 57, a union of district employees, for July 1, 2024 to June 30, 2027.
